1) Enter a track name
2) Stand at start/finish and press START GPS
3) Complete one lap to the same line
4) GPS stops automatically when you cross again
5) The arrow on the line is the start direction; swap the two points to reverse it
6) AUTO CP generates checkpoints automatically
7) Save

1) Enter a track name
2) Place 2 points for the start/finish line
3) The arrow is the start direction; swap the two points to reverse it
4) Move points with drag for precise positioning
5) Add exactly 4 checkpoint points
6) Tap a point to select, drag to move, UNDO to delete
7) Save

1) Enter a track name
2) Stand at the start and press START GPS
3) Drive the route and press STOP GPS at the finish
4) Start and finish lines are taken automatically from GPS
5) The arrow on the start line is the timing direction; swap the two points to reverse it
6) AUTO CP generates checkpoints
7) Save

7) Save
